audit_identity_and_drift_model.v2_manifest_hash_definition: sha256(canonical_json({'applicability': sorted_dict, 'contract_version': 2, 'effective_from': iso, 'symbols': list(symbols), 'universe_id': uid, 'universe_version': uver}))
audit_identity_and_drift_model.persisted_manifest_identity: manifest_hash column on capture run tables (NULL for v1 rows, non-null for v2 rows)

pit_capture_runs_changes.manifest_hash_constraint: CHECK ((contract_version = 1 AND manifest_hash IS NULL) OR (contract_version = 2 AND manifest_hash IS NOT NULL))
pit_capture_runs_changes.terminal_count_constraint: CHECK (status = 'started' OR requested_n = (known_n + not_applicable_n + unavailable_n + error_n))

pit_earnings_snapshots_changes.observation_origin: TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'provider' CHECK (observation_origin IN ('provider', 'manifest'))
pit_earnings_snapshots_changes.applicability_source: TEXT NULL CHECK (applicability_source IS NULL OR applicability_source = 'manifest')
pit_earnings_snapshots_changes.provider_call_attempted: INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (provider_call_attempted IN (0, 1))
pit_earnings_snapshots_changes.provider_nullability: NULLABLE (required if provider_call_attempted=1, strictly NULL if provider_call_attempted=0)
pit_earnings_snapshots_changes.request_started_at_nullability: NULLABLE (required if provider_call_attempted=1, strictly NULL if provider_call_attempted=0)
pit_earnings_snapshots_changes.response_received_at_nullability: NULLABLE (required if provider_call_attempted=1, strictly NULL if provider_call_attempted=0)
pit_earnings_snapshots_changes.provenance_mutual_exclusion_check: CHECK ((observation_origin = 'manifest' AND observation_status = 'not_applicable' AND provider IS NULL AND provider_observed_at IS NULL AND request_started_at IS NULL AND response_received_at IS NULL AND provider_call_attempted = 0 AND applicability_source = 'manifest') OR (observation_origin = 'provider' AND observation_status != 'not_applicable' AND provider IS NOT NULL AND request_started_at IS NOT NULL AND response_received_at IS NOT NULL AND provider_call_attempted = 1 AND applicability_source IS NULL AND request_started_at <= response_received_at))
pit_earnings_snapshots_changes.next_earnings_date_check: CHECK ((observation_status = 'known' AND next_earnings_date IS NOT NULL) OR (observation_status != 'known' AND next_earnings_date IS NULL))

pit_reference_capture_runs_changes.manifest_hash_constraint: CHECK ((contract_version = 1 AND manifest_hash IS NULL) OR (contract_version = 2 AND manifest_hash IS NOT NULL))
pit_reference_capture_runs_changes.terminal_count_constraint: CHECK (status = 'started' OR requested_n = (known_n + unavailable_n + ambiguous_n + error_n))

operational_execution_health_model.core_question: Did TradeX execute reliably and truthfully record provider/domain evidence?
operational_execution_health_model.does_not_answer: Did TradeX obtain every desired fact?

run_status_lifecycle.succeeded: error_n == 0 (all requested observations completed with valid evidence: known, not_applicable, unavailable, ambiguous)
run_status_lifecycle.partial: 0 < error_n < requested_n (some observations suffered technical/provider errors)
run_status_lifecycle.failed: error_n == requested_n, or fatal unhandled run-level failure

slot_health_truth_table.not_due: Non-trading day OR current time before slot scheduled time
slot_health_truth_table.healthy: Slot due, zero manifest/universe conflicts, both families have terminal SUCCEEDED runs (error_n == 0 for both)
slot_health_truth_table.degraded: At least one family has a run that remains STARTED (incomplete), OR at least one family has a terminal PARTIAL run (0 < error_n < requested_n) and neither has FAILED
slot_health_truth_table.failed: Slot due but expected family has zero runs (MISSING), OR manifest/universe conflict, OR total provider failure in either family (error_n == requested_n), OR preflight/auth failure, OR database crash, OR future manifest effective date

slot_level_aggregation.sparse_condition: At least one expected family has applicable_n > 0 and known_n == 0

evidence_completeness_model.operational_independence: Completeness tier NEVER alters operational health or process exit codes

exit_codes.2: operational degradation (partial technical error or incomplete run)
exit_codes.1: operational failure, manifest conflict, missing run, fatal error

migration_v7_to_v8.foreign_key_handling: PRAGMA foreign_keys=OFF during table swap, PRAGMA foreign_key_check before commit, PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON restored
migration_v7_to_v8.historical_preservation: all IDs, timestamps, fact hashes, fact JSON, provider data, error categories, and contract_version=1 preserved verbatim
migration_v7_to_v8.idempotency: PRAGMA user_version == 8 is no-op; PRAGMA user_version > 8 raises StoreError
migration_v7_to_v8.rollback: unhandled exception triggers ROLLBACK, database remains at Schema v7
